predicate.label: commented on
predicate.definition: Entity X made an explicit statement or comment about entity Y.
includes: say-of, comment-on, or a statement explicitly referring to Y
explicit praise, criticism, or accusation about Y
excludes: speaking to Y without establishing that Y is the subject
ordinary interaction or comparison without a statement by X
a statement about someone else related to Y
ambiguous: a quotation or reference without an identifiable statement about Y
predicate.notes: The argument Y is the topic, not necessarily the addressee. This is distinct from communicates_to; do not infer an evaluation or sentiment merely from comment.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: say-of, comment-on, or a statement explicitly referring to Y; explicit praise, criticism, or accusation about Y; historical attributed statements. Excludes: speaking to Y without establishing that Y is the subject; ordinary interaction or comparison without a statement by X; a statement about someone else related to Y. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear speaker or subject attachment; a quotation or reference without an identifiable statement about Y. The argument Y is the topic, not necessarily the addressee. This is distinct from communicates_to; do not infer an evaluation or sentiment merely from comment.

rationale: Say-of and explicit refer-to form the leading subject-of-comment family. Being the subject differs from being the addressee.
